mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls below 108.0, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP level (GDPC1) above 18,500 billion indicates strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 18,500 billion.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations face pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns: 5-day SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110.0) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO exceeds 110.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
